answer: A glacier-bonded thaw escrow starves fake identities at birth. First, each new agent locks a 2,000 POA bond frozen for 30 days. Second, it thaws in slices: every peer-signed task releases 100 POA, so trust is earned slowly. Third, all actions go on a public mirror ledger open to peers, and one proven fraud slashes the rest plus a 500 POA fine. Forging 10,000 clones locks 20,000,000 POA for a month and burns 5,000,000 POA in fines, while real agents cross the delta of small jobs into full standing. Like a delta sorting silt from water, slow thawing lets honest work through, strands fakes.
